run_svd_penalty: run svd_penalty on a PyTorch model to compute the largest singular value penalty across all layers
test_svd_penalty_exact: test svd_penalty with exact=True to validate singular value estimates using full SVD decomposition
test_svd_penalty_lowrank: test svd_penalty with lowrank SVD by setting dim and niters parameters for faster approximation
refactor_svd_penalty_proba: refactor svd_penalty to adjust the proba parameter for probabilistic penalty application during training
review_svd_penalty: review svd_penalty to understand how it penalizes the largest singular value of Conv and Linear layers
